description: Q4 (SortByKey exercise): bubblesort (BubbleSortPass) vs. topk (TopKPattern) taxonomic split, cross-validated against codet5p-110m-embedding.
generation_method: q4_labeled = q4_report[q4_report['strategy_label'].notna()][['file','strategy_label']]; for seed in range(10): shuffled = q4_labeled.sample(frac=1, random_state=seed).reset_index(drop=True); split_point = int(len(shuffled) * 0.7); train = shuffled.iloc[:split_point]; test = shuffled.iloc[split_point:]
structural_label_rule: bubblesort if BubbleSortPass_final >= 0.999; elif topk if TopKPattern_final >= 0.999; else excluded (the 22.4% 'neither' group)
source_report_csv: q4_report.csv (from batch_report.py's Q4 run, pulled from Drive, 776 rows)
reported_metric: bubblesort/topk accuracy: mean=0.936, std=0.021 (pooled over the 10 seeds' test predictions) -- std confirmed verbatim present in the notebook's raw content via Drive full-text search
